569-2226-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
569-2226-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Mist Raven by paying its mana cost.
When Mist Raven enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

874-1170-1329-8296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-8296.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2023-4289-4518-5295.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4068-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
3259-4068-8139.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4068-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1303-2158-3249--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1303-2158-3249--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

339-677-1115-6495.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

997-2738-4871-6248.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Phenomenon Investigators, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2921-3197-6854--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 5.

1117-3689-6518-7692.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
as a copy of Aminatou and with two or more loyalty counters on it

193-2724-3080-3908-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter as a copy of Aminatou that isn't legendary.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

225-565-1987-7487.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-565-1987-7487.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing land.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing land.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Zealous Lorecaster.
When the land and Zealous Lorecaster enter the battlefield, Zealous Lorecaster and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
225-565-1987-7487.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

1753-2388-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-2388-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

856-2292-4321-6277.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2292-4321-6277.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1563-2351-6460-7296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-6460-7296.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

1648-5702-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1648-5702-6441.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa of Shadowed Boughs
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1115-2366-3430-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1115-2366-3430-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-2374-6620.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2374-6620.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

301-1099-2486.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat.

4484-4871-5184-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4484-4871-5184-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

813-3617-5895.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Walk and Splash Portal.
813-3617-5895.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1479-3257-3908.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
Kodama of the East Tree, Spark Double, and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
Spark Double and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Spark Double token's trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

224-1525-4913-5702.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1525-4913-5702.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Springheart Nantuko trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger(s), choosing not to pay and creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

4321-5641-6010.notablePrerequisites:
Builder's Talent is at least level 2.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
4321-5641-6010.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token and a Food token.
When the Food token enters the battlefield, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

1750-2099-2793-5261-5740.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Assassin that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1750-2099-2793-5261-5740.description:
Activate Sarcatog's second ability by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using an Assassin, triggering Layla Hassan, returning Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2034-2713-4790-5004.description:
Activate Dino DNA's second ability by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Cathodion that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Cathodion token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Cathodion token dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2305-3851-4600.notablePrerequisites:
Frodo does not have summoning sickness.
Blade of Selves attached to Frodo.
You have been tempted by the Ring at least four times this game.
Opponents are unable to block creatures you control.
2305-3851-4600.description:
Activate Frodo's first ability by paying {W/B}{W/B}, causing it to become a 2/3 Halfling Scout.
Activate Frodo's second ability by paying {B}{B}{B}, causing it to become a 2/3 Halfling Rogue.
Declare Frodo as an attacker.
Frodo's myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of Frodo attacking each other opponent.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 for each Frodo token.
Deal combat damage using the Frodos.
The Frodos trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

1173-1984-2048-3454.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{W} the first turn, with {10}{R}{R}{W}{W} available each extra turn
1173-1984-2048-3454.notablePrerequisites: Sunforger attached to a creature you control.
1173-1984-2048-3454.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Final Fortune and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Final Fortune, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Final Fortune on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Angel's Grace and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Angel's Grace, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Angel's Grace on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Final Fortune triggers, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat from step 4.

1494-1906-5245.manaNeeded: {3}{G} each turn, with each mana being a different color
1494-1906-5245.description:
Cast Infuse with the Elements by paying {3}{G}, ensuring each mana spent is a different color, targeting Sage of Hours.
Sage of Hours and Feather trigger.
Resolve the Sage of Hours trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Feather trigger, causing you to exile Infuse with the Elements as it resolves.
Resolve Infuse with the Elements, putting four +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours and exiling Infuse with the Elements.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Feather triggers, returning Infuse with the Elements from exile to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

751-3091-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least four.
751-3091-4740.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying 2 life.
Defiler of Dreams and Aetherflux Reservoir trigger.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve the Defiler of Dreams trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until you have an empty library.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying fifty life, dealing fifty damage to any target.
Repeat step 7 as many times as desired.

636-2286.description:
At the beginning of each draw step, and after the player whose turn it is draws a card, Teferi's Puzzle Box triggers, causing all players to shuffle their hands into their libraries, and draw that many cards.
Because Spirit of the Labyrinth prevents any player from drawing more than one card, the active player will not draw any cards, and each other player will draw one card.
